steps.title: Analyze Project Dependencies
steps.description: Inspect build.gradle to ensure compliance with native constraints and remove non-essential external third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Upgrade Packaging Configuration
steps.description: Convert legacy packagingOptions block to modern Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2 compatible packaging specifications.

steps.title: Clean Dependencies Block
steps.description: Purge nanohttpd compilation dependency to preserve a lightweight, safe local runtime sandbox using native Android APIs.

steps.title: Optimize TextToSpeech API Compatibility
steps.description: Refactor standard voice synthesizer calls in MainActivity to properly support API level 21+ method definitions.

steps.title: Improve Drawing Touch Interactions
steps.description: Implement standard performClick overrides on custom DrawingView components to satisfy touch accessibility requirements.

steps.title: Verify UI Component Layout Bindings
steps.description: Validate IDs and alignments in the activity main layout ensuring they match active views programmatic references.

steps.title: Validate Manifest Namespace and Settings
steps.description: Double check the Android XML namespace, application properties, and initial activity configurations.

steps.title: Review Java 8 Language Specifications
steps.description: Verify the code is fully compatible with Java 8 specifications without modern lambdas or restricted API classes.

steps.title: Clean Build Caches
steps.description: Prepare the environment directories and build files for standard artifact assembly.

steps.title: Building Alphabet Explorer
steps.description: Compile sources and build the final debug APK package structure.
